text: {"thesis": "RSPYUSDT was best avoided into the 2026-03-11 macro catalyst because the tape was already in a confirmed downtrend with no offsetting positive evidence in the packet. The close of 674.23 sits 1.1% below the 20-day SMA of 682.07, and the packet states the SMA20 is below the SMA50, a classic bearish trend-stack alignment that typically precedes continuation rather than reversal. Momentum is negative on both horizons (5d -1.1%, 20d -1.0%), meaning the recent path of least resistance is lower and short-term bounce attempts have failed to reclaim the mean. The signal suite explicitly closes with 'Technical bias: bearish', and with ATR14 at 1.6% of price there is ample realized volatility to produce a further down-leg of roughly 10.5 points (one ATR) without any structural support being tested. Because this is a macro-catalyst event, a bearish pre-event technical posture raises the risk that any hawkish/risk-off catalyst is amplified by existing selling pressure and by stop-loss cascades under the 20-day SMA, while the absence of any positive momentum, volume expansion, or mean-reversion signal in the packet means there is no evidence-based offset to the downside skew. Net: the setup offers unfavorable asymmetry for longs and the highest-probability action is to avoid or stay short-biased until price reclaims the SMA20 and the SMA20/SMA50 relationship repairs.
